description: This file defines a Java class `LogWrapper` which implements the `LogNode` interface. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native logging utility `Log`, enabling log messages to be passed along a chain of `LogNode` objects. The class provides methods to set and get the next node in the chain, and overrides the `println` method to handle log output and chain continuation.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps the Android Log utility for use in a chain of log nodes, forwarding log messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and logs a message at the specified priority, optionally including a Throwable, then passes the message to the next LogNode in the chain if available.
